structural_change: S81U-CAP2: the flat s81sl_cap (22,261 sinks / one root, TT insertion 368.5 ps > 300) as a wires-only cluster of 3 hardened leaves with own roots: root leaf s81sl_cap_rt (S), tree leaf s81sl_cap_tr x2 (N; E instance MY). Seams registered both sides (nc RST flop -> n6 P1 flop), no added edge. S81-CAPRT 10-19: children are the CLOSED views (cap_rt c302169ce R 258.7 TT / 210.3 FF; cap_tr R 140.7 / 113.6); child_clock_ref boundary so the spine targets each child's routed boundary R (118 ps TT compensation rt vs tr). cap_rt resets 2 cycles after cap_tr (its 2-stage reset landing); no data crosses before a job starts.
why_floorplan: square 345.6 x 345.6 (S81-CAPRT 10-19 gen: closed cap_rt view is 259.2 x 116.64, so the 311 x 302 plan left a 13-um rt/tree seam and rt 6.5 um from the E face; the MY cap_tr LEF is off the M1-M9 tracks, no origin fixes it): u_rt 259.2 x 116.64 at (43.2, 43.2) (SRAM + side columns; clk + cfg / cw_n / tree seams on its N face), u_tw / u_te 90.72 x 86.4 both R0 at (43.2, 216) / (216, 216): 56-um seam channel to u_rt's N face; 82-um channel between the trees carries the clock spine, cfg / cw_n and te's rt bus (te's rt face is W in R0; rt_e enters the E face and crosses te on M6/M7). rt_w enters tw's outer W face; cw_s leaves u_rt's S face. All origins on the 43.2 lattice. A lattice-width cap_tr (MY-able) would restore the 311 x 302 plan.
